review_notes: Resubmission. This build adds camera and photo library permission descriptions for the SUPERHERO (service provider) verification selfie and document uploads, includes in-app account deletion (signed in: Account & privacy > Delete your S.O.S. account), and updates branding. S.O.S. connects drivers in metro Atlanta with nearby independent roadside assistance providers (towing, jump-starts, tire changes, fuel delivery, lockouts). It is not an emergency service. Use the demo account provided to sign in as a customer.
